newsitem.title: RUSSIA: ICN selected for final Polish negotiations.
newsitem.headline: ICN selected for final Polish negotiations.

text.p: ICN Pharmaceuticals Inc said Thursday that it has been selected by the Polish government to conduct final negotiations for the purchase of shares of a state-owned Polish pharmaceutical company that manufactures finished products.
ICN made the announcement from Moscow, where it held its quarterly board of directors meeting. ICN operates three plants in Russia.
ICN said it was selected for the final negotiations from among three competitors after the companies' bids were reviewed by the Polish Ministry of Treasury.
It said it would provide additional details about the proposed acquisition if the negotiations result in a successful transaction.
ICN manufactures and markets prescription and non-prescription pharmaceuticals and biotechnology products.
